entries.title: Genesis 25:4
segments: Midian; from whom came the Midianites south-east of the Dead sea.

entries.title: Genesis 25:6
segments: Concubines; Hagar and Keturah.
East country; Arabia, which lay south-east of Canaan, and the bordering regions.

entries.title: Genesis 25:7
segments: Threescore and fifteen; seventy-five.  This was thirty-eight years after the death of Sarah, and thirty-five after the marriage of Isaac.

entries.title: Genesis 25:8
segments: No degree of faith in God, or fidelity in his service, can prevent the approach of death; but as sin has entered, and death by sin, so the sentence of death has passed upon all men, because all are sinners.

entries.title: Genesis 25:9
segments: Cave of Machpelah;

entries.title: Genesis 25:11
segments: Lahai-roi;

entries.title: Genesis 25:13
segments: The sons of Ishmael; all these were heads of Arabian tribes.

entries.title: Genesis 25:16
segments: Twelve princes;

entries.title: Genesis 25:18
segments:
They; the descendants of Ishmael. 
 
  From Havilah unto Shur; the country between the Persian gulf and the Red sea. 
 
  He died--all his brethren; rather, his lot fell, that is, he dwelt. See note on

. 
 
The declarations of God, with regard to this world as well as the future, and with regard to bad men as well as good, will, in due time, all be accomplished.

entries.title: Genesis 25:20
segments: Padan-aram; meaning the plains of Aram, one of the Hebrew names of Mesopotamia, more especially the level part of it.

entries.title: Genesis 25:23
segments:
Two nations; those from whom should descend two nations, the Edomites and the Israelites. 
 
  Serve the younger; the descendants of Esau would be subject to the descendants of Jacob. 
 
The Lord sees the end from the beginning, and can describe events which are future with as much minuteness and accuracy as those which are past; and the truth of his declarations is abundantly proved by the dispensations of his providence.

entries.title: Genesis 25:25
segments: Esau; hairy.

entries.title: Genesis 25:26
segments: Jacob; meaning a supplanter, as by taking hold of the heel one causes another to fall, or overcomes him.

entries.title: Genesis 25:28
segments: Partiality of parents towards their children is a fruitful source of manifold evils, and will be conscientiously avoided by all who duly regard the comfort and welfare of their families.

entries.title: Genesis 25:29
segments: Sod; boiled.

entries.title: Genesis 25:30
segments: Edom; which means red.

entries.title: Genesis 25:31
segments: Birthright; that right which belonged to the first-born, of succeeding, on the death of his father, to the government and spiritual instruction of the family, officiating as their priest, offering sacrifices, and thus securing the blessings with which the performance of these duties would be connected.  A double share of the inheritance also fell to him.

entries.title: Genesis 25:34
segments:
Lentiles; a kind of pulse or coarse grain resembling peas and beans. 
 
  Despised his birthright; by giving up its temporal and spiritual blessings for the gratification of his appetite.

To disregard spiritual privileges and blessings and treat them as less valuable than personal gratifications, is a great sin.  It is viewed by God as profane, and exposes the soul to the loss of his favor.
